rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for reviewing and changing written material.

example.english: I need to revise the report.
example.jyutping: ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 sau1 goi2 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this for studying material again, especially when preparing for an exam.

example.english: I have an exam tomorrow, so I need to revise now.
example.traditional: 我聽日考試，而家要溫習。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 jat6 haau2 si3 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 wan1 zaap6
